entities.summary: Gavin Richard Harrison is an English musician. He is best known for his long tenures with the progressive rock bands Porcupine Tree, King Crimson and The Pineapple Thief (2016–present). Harrison's drumming has received many awards from music publications and earned praise from other musicians.
